description:
The Open Source Alternative To Notion.

AppFlowy is an open source alternative to Notion.
You are in charge of your data and customizations.
### :rocket：v0.14.5 (Latest)

Added database formulas and improved document recovery and desktop reliability.

#### New Features

• **Formula properties** — Added calculated database properties with property references, built-in functions, suggestions, and live previews. Formula results can be filtered, sorted, and summarized.

#### Improvements

• **Document recovery** — Improved recovery of unsaved document content after write failures, including when navigating between pages in the same app session.

#### Bug Fixes

• Fixed missing row-page content and overwritten page metadata during sync, and preserved subpages when their page details were not cached.
• Fixed errors when dragging database rows, accessing relations after a linked view was trashed, and opening row comments.
• Restored specific image-upload messages for file-size and workspace-storage limits.
• Fixed Linux RPM launch failures and crashes caused by SVG icon loading.

#### :warning：Action Required

• Self-hosted workspaces require **AppFlowy Cloud v0.18.10 or later**. Upgrade the server before upgrading to desktop v0.14.5.
